dogecoin.text:
4/ Enter Elon Musk

2020: Musk tweets about Dogecoin → price explodes.
One meme, another spike.
Then SNL… and we all remember how that ended (crash-landing).
Still, at peak, DOGE soared from $0.002 to $0.73 (that’s a 36,000% jump!).

3/ DOGE Army Does Good

2014: $30K in DOGE to send the Jamaican Bobsled Team to the Olympics.
Funded water wells in Kenya.
Even sponsored a NASCAR driver.
Jokes aside, Dogecoin was out there making a difference.

2/ A Meme Coin is Born

2013: Two engineers (Billy Markus & Jackson Palmer) make Dogecoin as a parody of Bitcoin.
“No max supply, no serious roadmap, just vibes.”
The internet: “Wait, this is actually cool.”
